Subject: MAP draft request + exec sponsor availability

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — product looked great and the team is excited to start a short evaluation. Our procurement and executive stakeholders asked for a simple mutual action plan (MAP) that ties evaluation milestones to procurement/contract milestones and an EB (executive briefing) window for final sign-off.

High-level asks from our side:
- A one-page MAP with milestones (pilot access, success criteria, procurement review, PO issuance).
- Proposed EB meeting date(s) for a 30–45 min executive sync (we're targeting the week of Mar 1).
- Confirmation of which Redwood exec(s) will attend.

Can you put together a draft MAP and suggest 2 EB windows? I'll loop in procurement (cc'd) and our evaluation lead.

Thanks — Sara
